answer: Each identity must bind its key to a sealed enclave, and the ledger issues only twelve attestations per epoch, each tied to one physical chip. Enclaves from one oasis of suppliers share serial ranges, so the ledger merges them into a dune of suspicion and freezes the whole cluster. Attackers must therefore buy chips from disjoint makers, and each extra identity consumes one scarce chip released on the quill schedule.
